historical_references.reference: Prerna was a famous poetess and philosopher in medieval India, known for her works in Sanskrit and Hindi languages. She is believed to have lived from 1370 to 1440 AD and was one of the earliest female poets in the Bhakti movement.

Prerna is also known as the 'Muse of Love' in Hindi poetic tradition. She is believed to have been a celestial nymph who inspired great love poets like Surdas and Mirabai to compose their famous works.
